statement: An attempt whose recorded workspaceBaseCommit is a well-formed commit id that no longer resolves is classified by the single typed base_unreachable code at every consumer that resolves that field against the repository, with no raw Git stderr reaching an operator surface; such an attempt is excluded from checkpoint receipt recomputation and ancestry pinning while never satisfying or being reported as verification; a rejection whose recorded base is unreachable is resolved only by a later same-frontier attempt or candidate at a reachable base whose paths cover every rejected source path and which carries its own later exact independent approval, with no operator waiver mechanism; the landing candidate and terminal aggregate anchor at a reachable recorded base while covering every recorded attempt path, and when no reachable base exists they report a typed actionable problem naming the required covering attempt instead of an unsatisfiable obligation; recording a fresh attempt at a live base on the same frontier is never blocked; and the explicit reproducibility probe reports whether recorded artifact bytes reproduce from reachable commits together with the candidate count and scan bound, and never names a substitute base.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
